question: Should this draft introduce mutating Claws workspace/persona file writes with `--workspace` and durable workspace-ref state before the Claws prerequisite stack lands, and should the new table be owned by the canonical shared-state schema?
rationale: This is a new user-facing mutating CLI mode plus persistent state and a workspace file-write boundary, so automation cannot decide product sequencing, workspace-root defaults, or permanent state-schema ownership.

options.title: Repair Schema Then Continue
options.body: Keep the PR open, but require `claw_workspace_file_refs` to move into the canonical shared-state schema/generated DB contract before merge.

options.title: Hold Behind Stack
options.body: Pause this draft until the prerequisite Claws validation and artifact-provenance branches plus the RFC direction are accepted.

options.title: Accept Feature-Local State
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the feature-local table and current workspace-root semantics, but then own the upgrade and doctor gap.

recommendation.title: Repair Schema Then Continue
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, but require `claw_workspace_file_refs` to move into the canonical shared-state schema/generated DB contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main code ownership signal for shared-state schema and safe workspace file helpers points to Vincent Koc.
